title: Recursive lower bounds for uniform set systems of bounded VC-dimension
summary: For integers $n\ge d+1$, let $\mathsf{M}_d(n)$ denote the maximum size of a $(d+1)$-uniform family on an $n$-element ground set with VC-dimension at most $d$. For $n\ge2d+2$, the classical construction of Ahlswede and Khachatrian, later generalized by Mubayi and Zhao, gives \[ \mathsf{M}_d(n)\ge \binom{n-1}{d}+\binom{n-4}{d-2}. \] We introduce a two-cover lifting construction and prove the recursive lower bound \[ \mathsf{M}_d(n)\ge \binom{n-1}{d}+\binom{n-4}{d-2}+\mathsf{M}_{d-3}(n-5) \] for every $d\ge 3$ and $n\ge d+3$.
